biomarkers.name: COL1A1-PDGFB fusion (t(17;22))
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic hallmark; imatinib active in advanced / unresectable disease (targets PDGFB/PDGFR)

biomarkers.name: Fibrosarcomatous transformation
biomarkers.clinical_use: Increases local recurrence and metastatic risk; adverse prognostic feature

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Uniform CD34+ spindle cells arranged in storiform (whorled) pattern infiltrating dermis and subcutis in tentacle-like projections
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Low-grade sarcoma; fibrosarcomatous transformation is the key adverse feature

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Not well characterised; typically minimal inflammation
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Storiform CD34+ spindle cells infiltrating fat in a 'honeycomb' pattern

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Dermal fibroblastic/mesenchymal cells with distinctive CD34+ phenotype
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Fibroblastic differentiation (CD34+, factor XIIIa variable) with characteristic storiform (whorled) growth pattern; low-grade sarcoma phenotype
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: COL1A1-PDGFB fusion is defining lineage event driving autocrine PDGF-β signalling; fibrosarcomatous transformation with loss of storiform pattern represents lineage progression toward higher-grade sarcoma phenotype
